newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: China said to be buying Argentine soyoil hungrily.
newsitem.headline: China said to be buying Argentine soyoil hungrily.

text.p: Chinese buyers are making big purchases of Argentine soyoil, Argentine traders said Wednesday.
"The Chinese are buying oil like hell. I believe they are more active on the oil side than in meal," a trader told Reuters. "They're active for June shipment basically."
The Chinese were not alone in the oil market, he said.
"Iran has been tendering. It has bought for June and July. It bought at $540 FOB for July yesterday. The day before yesterday it bought at $555, 25,000 tonnes for June shipment."
Algeria and Turkey have also been buying, he said.
Traders said they had heard nothing about sales of Argentine soybeans to China. There were rumors in Chicago that China had bought 45,000-50,000 tonnes of South American soybeans overnight.

"I haven't any confirmation of that. What people are talking about though is that some big firms are exporting Brazilian beans for July shipment at 24 under to the United States," another trader said.

Another rumor in the Argentine market was that the flow of soybeans would reverse later in the year and that Brazilian crushers were already negotiating to import U.S. beans for November, when they would run out of their own crop.
